# Grammar Master — Gerunds vs. Infinitives

> Interactive English grammar course teaching gerunds and infinitives across basic, intermediate, and advanced levels with personalized AI-generated exercises and progress tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page for students and teachers.
- [Student Entry](/student): Students enter their access code to start.
- [Teacher Login](/teacher/login): Teacher portal sign-in.
- [Course Home](/home): Choose a level to practice.
- [Module 1 — Basic](/module/1): Fundamentals of gerunds and infinitives.
- [Module 2 — Intermediate](/module/2): Common patterns, exceptions, and verb lists.
- [Module 3 — Advanced](/module/3): Native-level nuances and meaning changes.
- [Module 4 — Mixed](/module/4): Mixed practice across all levels.
- [Reference Guide](/reference): Complete reference of gerund and infinitive verb patterns.
